statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
A 48-hour Holter monitor, CPT code 93226, was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to capture the rhythm during symptomatic periods and assess the burden of arrhythmia
The symptoms are documented in support of diagnosis codes I48.0 and I49.9
The monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate the arrhythmia for further management
